title: Document ordinary host records' older-reader and binary rollback limits
outcome: Make the host contract and landing guidance state that optional turn outcomes and ordinary host receipts are unreadable or unhealthy for pre-change readers, so producers wait for affected readers to exit before emission.
acceptance: Host contract states that unadmitted_turn.outcome and host_* work-operation receipts cannot be produced until no older Engram reader of the affected store remains, including readers outside TermAl

Guidance distinguishes unchanged-schema readiness from reader compatibility and states that rolling back after emission makes older doctor/import unhealthy, without deleting history or adding a registry
